hypotheses.name: dirty_fuel_filter
hypotheses.diagnostic_step: Locate the primary (water separator) and secondary fuel filters. Inspect the sediment bowl on the primary for water/debris. If the genset has a vacuum gauge on the filter head, read it with engine at rated speed; otherwise crack the bleed screw on the secondary and observe flow rate.
hypotheses.expected_result: Sediment bowl clear of water and particulate. Vacuum gauge reading below 4 inHg (about 13 kPa) at rated speed. Fuel emerges from bleed screw as a steady clean stream, not a dribble.
hypotheses.if_confirmed: Drain water from the separator. Replace both primary and secondary filter elements. Bleed the fuel system and re-check idle stability for at least 2 minutes.
hypotheses.if_ruled_out: Fuel filtration is adequate. Move to air_intake_blocked hypothesis.

hypotheses.name: air_intake_blocked
hypotheses.diagnostic_step: Stop the engine. Remove the air cleaner cover and inspect the primary air filter element against a bright light. Check the restriction indicator (if fitted) and inspect the intake tract from filter to turbo/manifold for collapsed hoses, rodent nests, or foreign objects.
hypotheses.expected_result: Light passes visibly through the pleats of the filter. Restriction indicator is green / not tripped (typically trips at 25 inH2O / 6.2 kPa). Intake tract is clear and hoses are firm, not collapsed.
hypotheses.if_confirmed: Replace the air filter element. Clean the housing. If restriction indicator is fitted, reset it. Re-check smoke and idle after restart.
hypotheses.if_ruled_out: Air intake is clear. Move to injector_fouling hypothesis.

hypotheses.name: injector_fouling
hypotheses.diagnostic_step: With engine at idle and eye/hearing protection on, briefly loosen each injector return-line fitting or high-pressure line union one at a time (only quarter-turn, using a rag) and note whether idle roughness changes. A cylinder whose injector is dead will show no change when isolated.
hypotheses.expected_result: Isolating each healthy cylinder should cause a noticeable drop in RPM and increase in roughness. A cylinder that produces no change when isolated is the fouled/failed one.
hypotheses.if_confirmed: Remove the identified injector, send for pop-test and cleaning, or replace. Inspect nozzle spray pattern — should be a fine even cone at correct opening pressure per manufacturer spec (typically 180-220 bar for indirect injection).
hypotheses.if_ruled_out: All cylinders contribute evenly. Escalate: check valve clearances, compression per cylinder, and injection pump timing (defer to expert).
